body:
You don't need to clear the whole history.
```suggestion
		EditorUndoRedoManager::get_singleton()->clear_history(get_scene_history_id(p_idx));
```

@KoBeWi 
Do you mean not clear history? Because I need `set_history_as_unsaved()` to mark current scene as `unsaved`.

`clear_history()` with `p_increase_version` set to `true` (default) automatically marks the scene as unsaved.
`clear_history()` with no arguments (like you did) will clear the history for all scenes, which is unnecessary here.
